title: The Chinese vase on the shelf
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：Chinese　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 Chinese 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the grower wrote of ① a Chinese vase on the shelf in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so Chinese that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the Chinese ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the Chinese vase on the shelf that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too Chinese to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the Chinese ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a Chinese lesson after school, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as Chinese as the lesson after school they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was Chinese or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something Chinese, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite Chinese; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the Chinese ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another Chinese vase on the shelf in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less Chinese than anybody had expected. ⑩ The Chinese lesson after school that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the Chinese ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 中国（前置定语 a Chinese vase on the shelf：1975 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件中国的瓷瓶）
B. adj. 中国／中文（两处加强说法：so Chinese that … 与 no less Chinese than …）
C. adj. 中国／中文（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 中国（表语 too Chinese to do：母亲觉得它太中国，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 中文（前置定语 a Chinese lesson after school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩中文的课）
F. adj. 中文（同级比较 as Chinese as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩课后的中文课相比）
G. adj. 中文（后置定语 something Chinese：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 中文（受程度副词修饰 quite Chinese：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a Chinese vase on the shelf
the Chinese vase on the shelf that
The Chinese lesson after school that

answers.why: Chinese 意为“中国”，1975 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件中国的瓷瓶”，此处作前置定语 a Chinese vase on the shelf。
Chinese 意为“中国”，此处用 so Chinese that 结构，说它中国到大棚里没人敢靠近。
Chinese 意为“中国”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的中国架上的瓷瓶，等于最高级的说法。
Chinese 意为“中国”，母亲认为这件东西“太中国了，谁也用不上”，too Chinese to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
Chinese 意为“中文”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩中文的课”，此处作前置定语 a Chinese lesson after school。
Chinese 意为“中文”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩课后的中文课一样中文”，同级比较用 as Chinese as。
Chinese 意为“中文”，收成账上那半行字要的是“中文的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something Chinese。
Chinese 意为“中文”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当中文”，quite 修饰原级 Chinese。
Chinese 意为“中文”，no less Chinese than 表示“其中文不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之中文不亚于任何人的预料。
Chinese 意为“中文”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的中文课”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件中国的瓷瓶。（a Chinese vase on the shelf）
它中国到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so Chinese that …）
母亲觉得它太中国，谁也用不上。（too Chinese to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩中文的课。（a Chinese lesson after school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩课后的中文课一样中文。（as Chinese as …）
到了 1982 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件中文的东西。（something Chinese）
answers: In 1975 the grower wrote of a Chinese vase on the shelf in the ledger.
It was so Chinese that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too Chinese to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a Chinese lesson after school.
He said nobody would call it as Chinese as the lesson after school they had once had.
By 1982 the ledger asked for nothing but something Chinese.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 Chinese 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the grower wrote of a Chinese vase on the shelf in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the Chinese vase on the shelf that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too Chinese to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a Chinese lesson after school, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite Chinese, and everybody laughed.
The Chinese ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
